remarks: Wow! A rare opportunity to own a spacious 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath ranch situated on 2.75 private acres in the heart of Williamsville! Step inside through the welcoming front foyer and discover a home filled with warmth and character. The kitchen features beautiful oak cabinetry and charming brick archways, creating a cozy farmhouse or Italian countryside ambiance. The combined living and dining room provides a comfortable space for everyday living and entertaining. The expansive family room features a vaulted ceiling, a cozy wood burning fireplace, and a newer sliding glass door that opens to the back deck. Ample closet space is found throughout the home, and all bedrooms are generously sized. The exceptionally spacious primary suite includes a private ensuite bath. Outside, enjoy your own peaceful retreat with a charming gazebo, the perfect spot to relax and appreciate the privacy of the beautiful backyard. The partially fenced backyard offers added convenience and space to enjoy the outdoors. The home also features a complete tear-off roof replacement from 2021, offering added peace of mind. This well-loved home is ready for its next owners to bring their own style, personal touches and memories. Square footage is different than tax records indicate, current square footage measured by agent.
